narr: A strong thunderstorm passed across the Town of West Jefferson, NC during the afternoon of August 20th, and produced rainfall rates briefly of up to 6 inches per hour. CREST Unit Streamflow during the event maxed out at around 850 cfs per mi^2, while the FLASH 1-hour ARI was observed at 5:20 pm EDT as high as a 25-year event.
ev: Heavy rain caused Little Buffalo Creek to overflow its banks several inches deep across South Main Street in the Town of West Jefferson. No damage was reported to the road, which was open to traffic after the water receded.
lsr: Water overflowed the Little Buffalo Creek and washed over portions of South Main Street in West Jefferson in Ashe County North Carolina.
